515:t_024:6.en:
$$シン$$
「But we're not only protecting $$プラント$$!」

515:t_026:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Magnificent, all of you.」

515:t_026:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Until we meet again, $c.」

515:t_027:0.en:
$$シン$$
「What the hell is that guy!?」

515:t_027:1.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Defending $$プラント$$ comes first right now.」

515:t_027:2.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Let's do this, $$キラ$$. $$ラクス$$ is making her move in $$プラント$$ too.」

515:t_027:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wake up, $$リディ$$. $$ナチュラル$$s and $$コーディネイター$$s are the same human beings!」

515:t_027:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The existence of $$クロノ$$, trying to snuff out that possibility, is wrong!」

515:t_027:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems you can no longer come up with a logical rebuttal.」

515:t_027:9.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「We may be able to stop him now!」

515:t_027:11.en:
$$キラ$$
「We'll fight too...! With these feelings and the power entrusted to us!」

515:t_028:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Damn it all! I can't accept something like this!!」

515:t_028:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「What do you know about me!? My blood...」

515:t_028:3.en:
$$シン$$
「What's blood, what's fate!? What good is being bound by things like that!」

515:t_028:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「We're free! No one else can decide the future!」

515:t_030:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The Reformists are retreating too.」

515:t_030:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「What on earth were those guys...」

515:t_031:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Retreat confirmed for both the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives and the Reformists.」

515:t_031:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The $$ラー・カイラム$$ and the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ say they'll join us here, too.」

515:t_031:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Mission completion confirmed... Good work, everyone.」

515:t_031:3.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The man who was piloting that black Gundam... He's the same as me.」

515:t_031:5.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Bound by a mission that was never meant to exist, he lost sight of what truly matters...」

515:t_031:6.en:
$$シン$$
「But you found it again. That's why you were able to come back to us.」

515:t_031:8.en:
$$アスラン$$
「We got word from Captain $$バルトフェルド$$. It seems things at $$アプリリウス市$$ have been settled too.」

515:t_031:9.en:
$$キラ$$
「Looks like $$ラクス$$ and the others did a great job.」

515:t_031:10.en:
$$アスラン$$
「We can't afford to lose to you guys.」

515:t_031:11.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Look! It looks like $$ラクス$$ is about to make a statement!」

515:t_032:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Enemy units have infiltrated $$アプリリウス市$$!」

515:t_033:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「At this rate, $$プラント$$ will...!」

515:t_034:0.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It's been a while since I felt this rhythm...」

515:t_034:2.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Of course! I'm $$ザフト$$ Red too, you know!」

515:t_100:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$! This $$バンシィ$$ will destroy your $$ユニコーン$$ and protect $$ラプラスの箱$$!」

515:t_100:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Why are you so fixated on the Box!?」

515:t_100:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「For all of humanity! I will seal the Box away forever, for the sake of the world!」

515:t_100:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you have the right to decide that!?」

515:t_100:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「I do! I was given the $$バンシィ$$ to carry out that mission!!」

515:t_101:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Stop it, Ensign $$リディ$$! If you keep riding the $$バンシィ$$ in your rage like this, it'll end in something irreversible!」

515:t_101:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up, enhanced human! It's convenient that you showed up!」

515:t_101:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「I have a contract with them, too! I'm capturing you!」

515:t_101:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm not about to fall behind a man who's being thrown around by his machine!」

515:t_101:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Wake up! Don't use that talent of yours for something like this!」

515:t_102:1.en:
$n
(If $$マキ#pilot$$ had come out onto the battlefield just now, what would I have done...?)

515:t_103:0.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I prepared this $$レジェンドガンダム$$ for the day I'd have to fight you.」

515:t_103:2.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「But I'm glad... that it never came to that.」

515:t_103:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's go, $$レイ#pt136$$! We'll each fight to protect the future we chose!」

515:t_103:7.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
(I'm glad for you, $$シン$$ and $$レイ#pt136$$.)

515:t_103:8.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
(Friendship between guys... I'm a little jealous...)

515:t_104:0.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$キラ$$! From here on, I'm fighting alongside you!」

515:t_104:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'm happy. To be able to fight alongside you again like this, $$アスラン$$.」

515:t_104:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「I know. What we have to do is end that fighting as soon as we possibly can!」

515:t_104:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's go, $$アスラン$$! Our feelings and our power are headed toward a future without war!」

515:t_105:0.en:
$$リディ$$
(Taking the lives of innocent civilians... The most shameful act for a soldier...)

515:t_105:1.en:
$$リディ$$
(But I have to do it...! No matter how many sacrifices it takes, $$クロノ$$ is the only one who can protect this world!)
